name: Fake Podcast
overview: Fake Podcast is a parody comedy web series launched in 2023 by Satish Ray and his team. Presented in a mock podcast format, the show humorously mimics celebrity interviews, influencer culture, and trending talk shows through satire and improvisation. Each episode features Satish Ray portraying quirky characters, alongside Abhishek Singh as host Prashn Kumar, whose sharp timing adds to the chaos. Written by Satish Ray, Abhishek Singh, and Nitesh Tiwari, the series delivers witty dialogues and pop-culture satire. With crisp editing, a studio-style setup, and fast-paced humor, Fake Podcast playfully spoofs modern media while offering pure entertainment on Satish Ray’s YouTube channel.
